algorithm.name: Root-Conditioned Counterfactual Transport
algorithm.core_definition: For every conflicting natural root, search a bounded longitudinal time-warp family that preserves the original root polyline and use s=(1-c)r+cq to compute transported OPR.
algorithm.paper_role: Operationalizes coercion as loss of protected natural-option probability mass rather than generic candidate risk classification.
